title: armed AtomicBool mirrors Phase::Loading, set by hand beside the phase change
trigger: LockedDown sets phase=Loading and armed=true in two statements; Closing never clears armed
effect: none today (Closing returns before any armed event is read)

title: quill://unread watcher thread sleeps in a loop (WATCH_WAIT) while Quill is locked or signed out
trigger: An agent subscribes to quill://unread, the user locks Quill or signs out
effect: A detached per-connection thread wakes every 10 s doing nothing until the connection ends; bounded by the connection and 4 connections
fix: park the watcher on crate::wake::AGENT (wake_wait::sleep_or_wake) instead of a bare sleep

title: td_call offset tokens are not dropped when an account logs out; keys are reused
trigger: Agent runs searchMessages through td_call, user logs out; another Telegram user signs in under the same account-<n> key; the same agent replays the old quill-offset token
effect: Token is bound to account.0+agent+method, so reveal() accepts it and passes the old user's offset (date,chat_id,message_id) into the new account's request; results stay redacted by grants, so only a wrong page
fix: add td_offset::forget_account to account_data::forget (or bind the token to client_id)
